requirements.name: parameterized sat<W> and saturating addition
requirements.evidence: The registered !sat.int<W> type accepts widths 2 through 63 and one generic sat.add lowering emits signed bounds from W.

requirements.name: generic type checking and operator resolution
requirements.evidence: One width-independent pass validates nested operand and result types; the mixed-width test is rejected.

requirements.name: nested storage conversion and collision-checked helpers
requirements.evidence: Tensor element types are converted through an int64 carrier and generated shape-specific helpers are reused or rejected on a symbol/type/width collision.

requirements.name: execute scalar and tensor cases through two targets
requirements.evidence: The native shared-library path executes every frozen case exactly. ONNX-MLIR has no second executable C or deterministic-VM target corresponding to the frozen contract. Emitted ONNX and LLVM IR are intermediate forms, not a second execution path.

requirements.name: negative diagnostics
requirements.evidence: Invalid widths, mixed widths, absent accelerator registration, missing node mappings, duplicate mappings, and helper collisions all fail deterministically.

boundary: ONNX-MLIR can host the parameterized type and lower the unchanged ONNX fixture to a correct native artifact, but it does not provide the contract's second executable target representation. The task is therefore unsupported at that mandatory requirement rather than relabeled as a pass.
